reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest devtalk on the new movement mechanics in Provincia! Say goodbye to teleporting units and hello to realistic formations. Our soldiers will now turn and march as a cohesive unit, maintaining their positions and spacing. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: Revamping Unit Movement in Provincia!
